svg.title: 0-based half-open slices in 1D and axis reductions on a 2D (rows, cols) grid
svg.desc: Left panel shows 1D array a = np.array([10, 20, 30, 40, 50]) with 0-based indices 0..4 and negative indices -5..-1, illustrating why half-open slice a[1:4] includes index 1 (20) and excludes stop 4 to return [20, 30, 40] while strided slice a[::2] returns [10, 30, 50]. Right panel shows a 2 by 3 grid [[1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]] where axis=0 collapses down rows to per-column shape (3,) [11, 22, 33], axis=1 collapses across columns to per-row shape (2,) [6, 60], and the axis number names the dimension that gets collapsed.
